    Translation

    7063. Nājiya b. Jundub b. Kaʿb, also said b. Kaʿb b. Jundub, al-Khuzāʿī: also a Companion; ʿUrwa b. al-Zubayr was his sole transmitter. Those who conflated him with the preceding man were mistaken, and God knows best. [The four Sunan.]

    Taqrīb al-Tahdhīb no. 7063, ed. ʿAwwāma, p. 557

    ناجية ابن خفاف بضم المعجمة وبفائين العنزي بفتح المهملة والنون ثم زاي الكوفي عن عمار مقبول من الثالثة وقع في الرواية غير منسوب وصحح ابن المديني وغيره أنه ابن خفاف ووهم من زعم أنه ابن كعب س

    Translation

    7064. Nājiya b. Khufāf (ḍamma on khāʾ; two fāʾs) al-ʿAnazī (fatḥa on ʿayn and nūn followed by zāy) al-Kūfī, who transmits from ʿAmmār: acceptable; third generation. In the narration his lineage was omitted, but Ibn al-Madīnī and others established that he was b. Khufāf; those saying b. Kaʿb were mistaken. [Al-Nasāʾī.]

    Taqrīb al-Tahdhīb no. 7064, ed. ʿAwwāma, p. 557
